items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Lagoa Formosa (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Dec 3 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
